name: perspective
label: Perspective
css: .style-perspective { position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF) 0%, var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF) 85%, rgba(0, 189, 125, 0.03) 100%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .style-perspective::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -30%; width: 800px; height: 800px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 189, 125, 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-perspective > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .style-perspective .hook { font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -2px; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 85%; text-transform: uppercase; } .style-perspective .text { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; max-width: 80%; opacity: 0.85; } .style-perspective .step { position: absolute; top: 48px; right: 48px; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--slide-primary, #00BD7D); opacity: 0.12; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -4px; } .style-perspective .brand { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #00BD7D); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; } .slide-code.style-perspective { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #0f0f0f 85%, rgba(0, 189, 125, 0.05) 100%); } .slide-code.style-perspective::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 189, 125, 0.12) 0%, transparent 70%); } .slide-code.style-perspective .hook { color: #ffffff; } .slide-code.style-perspective .text { color: #e5e7eb; } .slide-code.style-perspective .step { color: rgba(0, 189, 125, 0.25); } .slide-code.style-perspective .brand { color: #00BD7D; } .slide-insight.style-perspective { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 85%, rgba(0, 189, 125, 0.06) 100%); } .slide-insight.style-perspective::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 189, 125, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); } .slide-insight.style-perspective .hook { color: #f1f5f9; } .slide-insight.style-perspective .insight-text { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #f1f5f9; max-width: 85%; opacity: 0.95; } .slide-insight.style-perspective .text { color: #cbd5e1; opacity: 0.9; } .slide-insight.style-perspective .step { color: rgba(0, 189, 125, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-perspective .brand { color: #00BD7D; }
